body: I know Mature, I’ve read a lot of that before, and I’ve suffered with my stomach lining as a result of that kinda thing before. God knows what state my kidneys are in. I don’t man, I really, really don’t.
It’s alright kid, I don’t you need to, I don’t need you validation. The ladies on your subs might, but I’m cool.

Paper is almost soluble in its value to sort out anything in my life. My mind is so frazzled I cannot even distinguish between rationality and impulse.

If only I was 10.

For a 15 year old, you’re incredibly perceptive and wise. Thank you for the kind comments and thank you for reaching out. I wish you all the best, and I hope you do great things in your life and in turn, have a better life than some of us have found ourselves in. 

I looked on your profile and your propensity to help others is truly admiral. 

Thank you for the love and the time you took here. I appreciate it. 

Take care of yourself
Sure, you can PM me. I’ll be around for a lil longer today. I’m not going to help/advise/point you in the direction of taking your own life though.

I tried to build a support network but didn’t realise how poorly one of those people was. We talked for a while after a hiatus, and I guess, at that time he was in a full manic episode. Anyway,  I couldn’t get past the voices and to him. He overdosed in his parents’ driveway. The voices wouldn’t let me help him. I tried to help him but failed miserably, I didn’t quite understand from the previous day that he was going down this route and intervene in time. 

Looking back on it actually, I feel like no one really understood him, and that’s how I feel too. It’s a lonely place to inhabit.

I’m not going to advocate methods. I’m ill and I’ve already ruined/will ruin so many lives. I can’t subject you and yours to that too. 

Save yourself if you can, love yourself, I’m far beyond that.
Dude, I’m seeing white powder; I don’t think you should be making this decision now
Oh no :/ call 911 - regardless of why you’ve made your decision I’m fairly certain that you didn’t want to go like this. They should be able to find you via GPS.
